messages:
devon: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing hybrid credits + local leases to reduce global coord but keep fairness. sanity checks?
tara: short sketch please.
devon: front proxies keep tiny local lease pools per-tenant. central allocator slowly replenishes pools with credits. tokens remain as hard caps.
izzy: eviction story?
devon: central can publish InvalidateCredit(id). proxies stop new attaches; in-flight run to ttl. soft-drain avoids hard cancels.
leo: accounting: avoid double-counting. rule: charge when credit is granted (central) else local is uncharged until conversion.
chandra: conversion: if local TTL expires and request retries, we attempt central acquire and then charge. streams reattach every N tokens (N=256 default).
tara: abuse handling?
devon: allocator has rolling abuse_score. if > threshold, stop replenishment -> tenant falls back to local-only + strict tokens.
izzy: detector design: fast EWMA rps+5xx in hot path; 1% sample for heavy heuristics offline. heavy signals are advisory.
leo: API: AcquireCredit(tenant, route_hint, requested_ru)->credit_id, granted_ru, ttl_s, policy_flags. AttachLease(credit_id, request_id)->lease_id. Publish InvalidateCredit on revoke.
chandra: metrics: credit_replenish_latency, local_lease_hit_ratio, conversion_rate, blocked_by_abuse. dashboards and alerts on conversion spikes.
tara: ops: dashboard, runbook, kill-switch for central allocator, sampling pipeline. rollout: opt-in beta then ramp.
ops-bot: job created: central-credit-health -> #eng-oncall daily 08:30 UTC.
devon: thanks, I'll post a compact RFC with proto stubs and a small simulator.
